description: Documented corrections to goal_reachability results caused by pipeline defects. Raw result files are left unchanged; make_comparison_figures.py and evaluate_goal_preserving.py apply these on read.

corrections.reason: Pipeline defect: pyuppaal crashed on a <label> without x/y drawing coordinates (int() of None), so a valid candidate consumed attempt 1 and was never accepted. Fixed in llm_fixer.add_missing_layout.
corrections.evidence: attempt1.xml re-verified with verifyta on 2026-10-08 after the fix: both original properties (queries 1, 2) and both goal queries (3, 4) satisfied.
